component.name: JamBaLinux Sonic Core
component.summary: Battery, equalizer, 3D sound and lights of the JBL Quantum 810 Wireless

description.p: The JamBaLinux Sonic Core app: headset battery in the tray, a ten-band equalizer, 3D sound, night mode, media controls and the headset lights, with the Vivo, Hi-Fi and Leve themes. It needs the Sonic Core core installed on the computer (tools/install-user.sh --flatpak).
